'''Mae''' is an NPC who appears at the bar in [[Montelli Quarter]], [[Ragunna]]. She can only be seen there from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

After you interact with her, you will get a bottle of [[Nectarwine]]

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Mae:''' We've some really interesting options in the new wine list.
:'''Mae:''' "The Montelli Lounge draws inspiration from the Carnevale for its cocktails..."
:'''Mae:''' But honestly, isn't it a bit too lonely to drink alone...?
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Mae:''' The ball doesn't start for another three hours.
:'''Mae:''' Say, why don't you come to sit with me? Don't be so stiff.
:'''Mae:''' This round is on me, don't worry—I won't get you drunk.
:'''Mae:''' It's best to feel a bit tipsy at a time like this...
{{Dialogue End}}
